items.name: DividedPowers.RatAlgebra.dpow_eq_inv_fact_smul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (I : Ideal R) [inst_1 : Algebra ℚ R] (hI : DividedPowers I) {n : ℕ} {x : R},
  x ∈ I → hI.dpow n x = Ring.inverse ↑n.factorial • x ^ n

items.name: Polynomial.factorial_smul_hasseDeriv
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), ⇑(k.factorial • Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) = (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k]

items.name: DividedPowers.factorial_mul_dpow_eq_pow
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring A] {I : Ideal A} {a : A} (hI : DividedPowers I) {n : ℕ},
  a ∈ I → ↑n.factorial * hI.dpow n a = a ^ n

items.name: DividedPowers.dpow_smul
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring A] {I : Ideal A} {a b : A} (hI : DividedPowers I) {n : ℕ},
  a ∈ I → hI.dpow n (b • a) = b ^ n • hI.dpow n a
